With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z),ell=P2(S^3 L^2 z),eprime=P2(S^5 L^4 z^2),d=P2(S^9 L^4 A z^2),Y=P2(S^11 L^7 A z^3),k=P2(S^13 L^9 A z^4). Four internal maps use B2.1 affine extraction at FIXED dimension1024,K=128*h*A*M,charged field/matrix packages,at most2 eventual A1calls and exact stipulated ell-seed guard. Setq0=(4h+128hA+10)ell. Short E1 is direct B2.3. B5 is the fully supplied logarithmic-external-seed bootstrap: r-bit source padded to n=P2(r),w=ceil(log2 r),two1024-wise polynomial bit samplers,ell_s=n//2176000,kappa=ell_s//16000,weak outputM1=kappa//8,weak shared-field seedD1=5*(1000w)^2+2000w,direct A1D4 helper outputP2(D1),errorlog160w+10,and ceil((m-c)/M1) fresh external-seed rounds. theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^(901/100)*(log2(log2 N))^4. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^(901/100)*(log2(log2 N))^(4+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(901/100+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*ceil(log2 L))=o(k), including the four internal dimension1024 packages. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.
